Home.bio1: Hi! I'm Alejandro González Macías, a Software Engineering graduate from the University of Seville. I enjoy turning ideas into functional, maintainable, and scalable software, and I'm always interested in exploring new tools and technologies to continue growing as a developer.
Home.bio2: My academic background has provided me with a solid foundation in software engineering, software architecture, and problem-solving. I'm curious, adapt quickly to new environments, and have a C1 level of English and Spanish as my native language. I'm currently looking for opportunities to grow professionally and contribute to meaningful projects.

Experience.text1: I recently graduated in Software Engineering and I'm currently looking for my first professional opportunity in the field.

ultimateggx.title: UltimateGGx
ultimateggx.description: A League of Legends match analysis web application that lets users explore summoner profiles, detailed match histories, interactive timelines, scoreboards, and minimap-based replays using Riot Games data.

ultimatewatch.title: UltimateWatch
ultimatewatch.description: A web application that unifies streaming platform catalogs into a single search experience and allows users to host synchronized watch parties with real-time chat and shared playlists.

keakit.title: KeaKit
keakit.description: A marketplace platform for renting items, hiring services, and creating personalized kits, making it easy to connect users with available products and services.

zeolite.title: Zeolite
zeolite.description: A web application for organizing fictional universes through graph visualization, custom entities, and automatic detection of narrative inconsistencies.

movies-ir.title: Movie Information Retrieval
movies-ir.description: A collaborative information retrieval project for searching and analyzing movie reviews using Boolean and TF-IDF retrieval models.
